label: ADS1014 Shunt Current Demo
info: An Inject node fires every second, triggering the periph-ads1014 node (gain ±0.256 V, 250 SPS) to read the voltage across a 0.1 ohm shunt. A Function node converts the shunt voltage to a load current (V / 0.1 ohm) and flags an over-current condition above 1 A in the Debug sidebar.

name: shunt voltage to current
